metadata.title: Unknown Disease Killing Adivasis in Bastar | बस्तर में अज्ञात बीमारी से मौत, ज़िम्मेदार कौन?
metadata.description:
There were reports in local media about an unknown illness killing people in Sukma and Narayanpur district of Maoist hit Bastar region.The Chhattisgarh health department has swung into action after residents of a remote village in Bastar’s Sukma district claimed that at least 8 people died there in one week due to an unknown illness. The administration, however, said that there was no single reason behind the reported deaths in the village.
